newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.12 rupees down at 42.02 to the dollar on Wednesday in the kerb market amid a shortage of dollars from abroad, dealers said.
They said despite the tight dollar supply the rupee might open stable on Thursday if today's sharp rise prompted profit-taking in dollars.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, set on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 5.10 percent, up from Tuesday's close at 4.70 percent.
